name: 09 Thunder Curtain Falls basin
purpose: The walkers' way into the Aqua Cavern: you come down the shaft walls, cross behind a 17 m curtain of 39 °C water, then sink into a steaming teal plunge pool where focused streams pound your shoulders.

ceiling_profile.note: A tall shaft whose north wall (y 76) is the B2 river lip; open to -40 over the curtain, rock overhang down to -50 over the south deck. The east wall (x 46) carries the portal throat and, above it, the view arch into the great vault (b3_cavern).

portals.note: Rock-cut throat in the shaft's east wall (x 46-50) leading out under the vault: the compressed passage before the terrace reveal. rimstone_stair starts here.
Top of the Falls Stair (B2). Descends the east, south and west shaft walls to the gallery.
Implied by falls_stair_1/falls_gallery: the stair's last run (x 10.5) enters the gallery.
Implied by falls_stair_2: the stair leaves the gallery through a 1.5 m rock-cut throat (y 74.5-76, solid rock between the shaft notch and the gallery).
Foot of the stair onto the east deck (x 42.7-46 stays clear to the portal throat).
High view arch (y 49-73, sill -57): the curtain's glow and spray read across the great vault.

hero.why: A 17 m sheet of hot water lit from behind by the gallery lanterns (b3_falls_gallery): it is the loudest, whitest, brightest thing in the shaft, the reason the stair exists, and the walkway behind it is the one place in the spa where you stand inside a waterfall.

anchored.why: Lookbook 09: stone seats set under focused streams for a shoulder massage. Spouts come out of falls_stair_2's retaining wall over the east edge of the pool, as the arched spouts under the walkway in concept 19 (right side).
Concept 19's timber building on the left: a robing/rest pavilion on the west deck facing the curtain, tucked under falls_stair_1 (which passes 7 m above).
Open (shaft) side of every flight and landing.
The deck is at -59.5 and the rim at -60.0: two 25 cm wet-stone seat steps along the south rim, where guests sit facing the curtain.

water.note: Matches layout. Its north edge (y 77) now runs 1 m past this footprint (y 76) under the gallery; see report.
Lip = layout w_thunder (12 m, the river's width); the sheet throws 2-3 m forward and lands in w_falls_pool.
Overflow slot (culvert under falls_stair_2) along the north side of the portal throat to the top rimstone tier (-60.5): downhill.

sightlines.see: Straight down the shaft: the white curtain lit amber from behind, the teal pool 20 m below, lantern dots on every landing.
Stepping off the stair into the gallery mouth: the curtain's edge glowing amber on the right.
East through the portal throat: the first rimstone tiers glowing teal-white under the vault - the next space's light.
Looking back west (arriving from the terraces): the curtain face-on through the throat, mist rolling out at ankle height.

concept.match: Low on the south deck looking north: the curtain centre frame, the gallery and its lanterns visible through/above the water, the timber pavilion on the left, arched spouts with seated bathers on the right, wet black rocks and an andon in the foreground, mist on the pool.

lights.why: Teal-white uplight in the plunge zone; makes the spray and the pool glow as in concept 19.
One lantern per landing: a dotted zigzag down the shaft walls.
Landing of falls_stair_2 and the two south deck corners.
Pools of light on the south deck with dark gaps between; points toward the curtain.
Flank the portal throat so the exit reads from across the pool.

dressing.why: Big wet boulders breaking the plunge, as in 19.
Dark silhouettes either side of the pavilion against the spray (19, left).

mood.palette: amber gallery band behind white water, teal pool, black wet basalt
mood.mist: thick spray column at the plunge, knee-high mist over the whole pool
